source: NAR official monthly race data (approximately 3 years); raw archives are not retained

data_quality_audit.policy: Coverage diagnostics only; missing values are not imputed as observed facts and this report does not imply predictive value.

method.prediction_order: date-batched chronological; every race on a date is predicted before any result from that date updates history or model weights
method.market_value_policy: Simulate win bets only when calibrated model probability multiplied by timestamped official pre-off win odds meets a fixed threshold; thresholds are reported independently and not selected on test folds.
method.probability_calibration: temperature fitted on chronological prequential training predictions; out-of-sample calibration reported per walk-forward fold
method.ticket_policy: Expanded fixed top-rank ticket portfolio per race; 100 JPY per ticket; not a betting recommendation
method.ticket_generation: Top-5 rank-based portfolio: win top 2; place top 3; wide all pairs among top 3; quinella top 2; exacta first-place top 2 x second-place top 3 excluding same horse (4); trio all combinations from top 5 (10); trifecta first-place top 2 x second-place top 5 excluding first x third-place remaining top 5 excluding first and second (24). Each ticket costs 100 JPY.
limitations: No historical pre-race odds feature; NAR monthly odds are confirmed odds and are not used.
All payout rows for dead-heat races are retained and matched across every winning combination.
Ticket ranks use field-size-normalized historical finishes; probabilities are temperature-calibrated and evaluated in rolling holdout folds.
Missing or incomplete historical rows are excluded where necessary.

out_of_sample_validation.method: three rolling-origin folds with non-overlapping test windows; weights frozen within each test window; prior results added only after all races on a date are scored; market-value bets use timestamped official pre-off odds snapshots

recent_history_comparison._method: Same chronological holdout races and same trained weights; before excludes each horse's last-five-run form/venue/distance inputs, after includes them. Sire, jockey and age features remain identical.

out_of_sample_validation.selection_rule: Each fold uses only strictly earlier training data; test weights remain fixed and race results are added to history only after the entire date is scored.

odds_snapshot_archive.note: The closest valid snapshot from 30 to 2 minutes before post time is used; snapshots inside the final 2 minutes, post-off records, and monthly confirmed odds are excluded.

preoff_value_backtest.minimum_sample_rule: At least 100 races with bets and 300 tickets per threshold; a candidate additionally needs the race-cluster bootstrap 95% lower ROI bound above 100%. Threshold selection uses the first 70% of dates only; the last 30% remains untouched holdout.
preoff_value_backtest.policy: Flat 100-yen win bets only when saved calibrated win probability multiplied by timestamped pre-off win odds meets the threshold. Returns use official settled 100-yen payouts.
preoff_value_backtest.note: Only the closest valid pre-off snapshot from 30 to 2 minutes before post time per race is evaluated. No monthly confirmed odds are substituted.

preoff_ticket_type_backtest.selection_policy: Each bet type is evaluated and selected independently. Threshold selection uses only the first 70% of dates; the final 30% is untouched holdout. Candidate pass requires at least 100 races, 300 tickets, and a race-cluster bootstrap 95% lower ROI bound above 100%.
preoff_ticket_type_backtest.probability_model: Plackett-Luce top-three finish probabilities derived from calibrated win probabilities; combination odds are taken from the same timestamped official pre-off snapshot.

online_learning.note: Daily batch learning: all races on a date are scored before that date's results update weights for later dates.
